title.zh: 授予Faustino Nuyda在阿尔拜省Camalig市镇经营电灯、热力与动力系统特许经营权的法案
title.en: Act Granting Faustino Nuyda a Franchise for An Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Camalig, Province of Albay
title.orig: Act Granting Faustino Nuyda a Franchise for An Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Camalig, Province of Albay
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp đặc quyền cho Faustino Nuyda đối với hệ thống chiếu sáng, sưởi ấm và điện lực tại Thị trấn Camalig, Tỉnh Albay
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่ Faustino Nuyda สำหรับระบบไฟฟ้าแสงสว่าง ความร้อน และพลังงานไฟฟ้าในเทศบาล Camalig จังหวัด Albay
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan konsesi kepada Faustino Nuyda untuk sistem penerangan, pemanas, dan tenaga listrik di Kotamadya Camalig, Provinsi Albay
title.ms: Akta memberikan konsesi kepada Faustino Nuyda untuk sistem lampu, haba dan kuasa elektrik di Perbandaran Camalig, Wilayah Albay

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1953/ra_916_1953.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six, as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-two, and to the provisions of the Constitution, there is granted to Faustino Nuyda for a period of fifty years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege, and authority to construct, maintain, and operate an electric light, heat and power system for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and/or power for sale within the municipality of Camalig, Province of Albay.

It is expressly provided that in the event the Government should desire to maintain and operate for itself the system and enterprise herein authorized, the grantee shall surrender his franchise and will turn over to the Government all serviceable equipment therein, at cost, less reasonable depreciation.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 20, 1953.
